review.result: Independent pe_inventory source/ASM/pin review; reported numeric issues fixed and targeted regressions pass; reviewer did not build in parallel.

limitations: No live visual, controller or in-game editor testing was performed. Tests establish handler/guard/callout behavior, not rendered appearance.

The engine owns future camera updates and all loaded geometry. The guards validate immediate reset/projection inputs and the introduced transition envelope; they do not prove every future calculation for arbitrary corrupted or modded editor resources.

CRT trigonometric implementations and the established original game execution environment remain assumed. Relevant local bodies and readonly constants are pinned; this is not whole-process tamper detection.
No lock is added around game-thread owner structures. Exact ABA replacement or arbitrary concurrent third-party mutation between checks is not distinguishable without an engine generation token.
Undo, redo, forced preview entry, grid editing and blueprint export remain unimplemented, with prior research limits unchanged. Earlier release packages remain byte-for-byte unchanged.
